chunks: Sa'd, from Sindī ibn Muḥammad al-Bazzāz, from Abān ibn ʿUthmān, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Yaʿfūr, who said:

I said to Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام: “Do I pray while a woman is beside me and she is praying?” He said: “No, unless she goes forward or you do; and there is no harm in your praying while she is beside you, seated or standing.”

key_terms.تَتَقَدَّمَ: to move ahead or be in front
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection

ai.seo_question: Can a man and a woman pray side by side in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the positioning of a man and a woman during salat (prayer) when both are praying. It states that they should not pray side by side unless one is positioned ahead of the other, while it is permissible if she is beside him but not engaged in salat, whether seated or standing.
